description: Two lines compared on the same axes, with a legend identifying each series.
overview: Two series as smooth lines on shared axes, with a legend below. Use it to compare how two metrics move over the same period.
usage: Replace `chartData` and rename the series keys in the data, both `Line` elements and `chartConfig`. Add another `Line` with its own config entry for more series; the legend and tooltip pick them up automatically.
notes: Beyond four or five lines the chart gets hard to read; consider the interactive variant that lets readers toggle series.
